reports.title: BlackLine Announces Third Quarter Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: Total GAAP revenue is expected to be in the range of $195 million to $197 million.
Non-GAAP operating margin is expected to be in the range of 25.8% to 26.9%.
Non-GAAP net income attributable to BlackLine is expected to be in the range of $47 million to $48 million, or $0.67 to $0.68 per share on 72.4 million diluted weighted average shares outstanding.
